window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; items below were announced 9-10 November. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcement could be verified.

stories.headline: Colombian army destroys Nariño cocaine lab holding over 1.3 tonnes of product, and finds 2.7 tonnes of marijuana on a Putumayo barge
stories.body: Reported 10 November: an army brigade working with police and the DEA dismantled a lab in Taminango, Nariño, recovering 1,185 kg of cocaine hydrochloride and 158 kg of coca base, plus 264 gallons of chemical inputs; authorities estimate over $40 million in losses to the Franco Benavides structure. Separately, troops found about 2,700 kg of marijuana on a tug-style barge at Puerto Asís, Putumayo, linked preliminarily to Comandos de la Frontera. No arrests were reported.

stories.headline: FBI-led surveillance in Ibarra, Ecuador ends with 452 kg of cocaine seized and one trafficker held
stories.body: On 9 November, after three days of surveillance, Ecuadorian police working with the FBI's Rochester organized-crime task force, its Bogotá-Quito office and the DEA's New York division intercepted a load of about 452 kg of cocaine in Ibarra, Imbabura province, near the Colombian border. One suspect was arrested; his identity was not released.
